svg.text: Zero-Trust Network Controls, Multi-Subnet Segmentation & VPC-SC Perimeter (modules/network_and_psc)
4 Segmented Subnets (/19 Databricks, /22 Denodo VDP, /24 PSC, /24 ILB Proxy) | Private Cloud DNS (199.36.153.4/30) | Micro-Segmented Firewalls
CUSTOMER-MANAGED VPC: rd-lakehouse-vpc-mvp (REGIONAL ROUTING, AUTO_CREATE_SUBNETWORKS = FALSE)
• Hosts N4, C4, M3, and Z3 Databricks Worker Pools
• Outbound TCP :5432 -> HA Cloud SQL Hive Metastore
• Inbound TCP :443/:8443 from snet-denodo-vdp & PSC only
Shielded VM Regional MIG (n4-standard-8, Zones a/b)
• Outbound :443 -> Databricks SQL Warehouse PSC Endpoint
Terminates Databricks Control Plane Web UI, REST API,
Secure Cluster Connectivity (SCC) relay, and Serverless
SQL Warehouse JDBC traffic strictly inside the VPC.
PRIVATE SERVICE ACCESS (/20) & PRIVATE CLOUD DNS
PSA Peering: HA Cloud SQL Hive Metastore (:5432)
ZERO-TRUST GCP FIREWALL POLICY MATRIX (PRIORITY-ORDERED INGRESS & EGRESS CONTROLS)
[Prio 100 | EGRESS | ALLOW] -> 199.36.153.4/30 (TCP :443) | Allows GCS HNS, BigQuery StorageReadAPI, Cloud KMS, Secret Manager
[Prio 150 | INGRESS| ALLOW] 10.169.0.0/22 -> [databricks-worker] (:443, :8443) | Allows Denodo VDP Simba Spark JDBC pushdown
[Prio 250 | INGRESS| ALLOW] 35.235.240.0/20 (IAP) & GCP HC -> [denodo-vdp-node] (:22, :9090, :9443, :9996, :9999) | Zero-Trust Admin
[Prio 65534| EGRESS | DENY ] -> 0.0.0.0/0 (ALL PROTOCOLS) + INCLUDE_ALL_METADATA Logging | Blocks all unauthorized internet egress
Cloud NAT (rd-lakehouse-cloud-nat) is attached with ERRORS_ONLY logging strictly for allowlisted OS/driver package repositories.
• STS Landing, Primary HNS Lakehouse, Denodo Cache
Zero public internet exposure; perimeter locked
• 50 GB BI Engine + High-Throughput gRPC Read API
Accessible solely by sa-denodo-vdp inside perimeter
• External Hive Metastore credentials & JDBC tokens
Hardware-backed KMS protection across all tiers
• Databricks GKE Enterprise node pool management
• Regional HA Cloud SQL PostgreSQL 15 control plane
1. Zero Public IPs on Databricks workers & Denodo VMs
2. Firewall Rule Priority 65534 denies all 0.0.0.0/0 egress
4. VPC-SC Perimeter blocks unauthorized project copies
